audit.whatIsWrong: The packet's defect line is accurate — not a single cooldown or sequencing cue anywhere in the entry. Three decisive interactions were entirely absent: Alpha Strike makes him untargetable mid-dash, Highlander makes him immune to slows, and Wuju Style adds true damage.
audit.why: Kit: Alpha Strike 20/19.5/19/18.5/18s, untargetable during the teleport and refunded by his basic attacks; Meditate a flat 10s channel that restores health and reduces damage taken; Wuju Style a flat 14s granting bonus TRUE damage; Highlander a flat 85s that makes him immune to all slowing effects. The slow immunity is the sharpest of these for Sylas specifically — Chain Lash's slow is his main tool for buying distance, and from level 6 it stops working on Yi entirely.
